name: Si-Ge Tersoff alloy (Tersoff 1989)
validity_notes: Tersoff Si-Ge alloy parameterization. Suitable for structural relaxation of Si, Ge, and SiGe configurations; validate the chosen composition and interface against experimental or higher-level data.
citation: J. Tersoff, Phys. Rev. B 39, 5566 (1989), with errata in Phys. Rev. B 41, 3248.
source_note: Derived from the Si-Ge subset of the LAMMPS SiCGe.tersoff potential; Si(D) labels normalized to Si.
license: Redistributed with LAMMPS; cite the paper above.
